subject: Pathway Labs — onboarding: PO policy offset proposal
content:
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@pathwaylabs.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@pathwaylabs.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding & billing: Pathway pilot — PO requirement question

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Pathway Labs is excited to pilot Redwood for our model-serving batch workloads. We have two quick operational asks to make onboarding feasible on our side:

- Do you require a company PO for month-to-month pilot spend under $5k?
- If a PO is required, can we route invoices to our central procurement team (they prefer a single monthly invoice) or would Redwood accept direct invoicing to the project?

I attached the SOW and our onboarding form so your procurement folks can review. If PO is required and Redwood can make an exception for pilot customers (signed SOW + prepayment or credit card), please let us know the documentation and approval path.

Appreciate a short checklist we can work against — we’d like to start by Oct 1.

Best,
Nora Patel
Head of Ops, Pathway Labs

Attachment: Pathway_Onboarding_Form_Fillable.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Re: Onboarding & billing: Pathway pilot — PO requirement question

Hi Nora —

Short answer: for pilots under $5k we often accept a no-PO path if the account meets our low-risk criteria, but procurement needs a one-page risk note + signed SOW. I looped in Priya (Procurement) and Marissa (Sales) to confirm the exact approval ladder and any temporary invoice routing options.

Quick asks for your team to speed review:
- Confirm billing email and invoice remit (central procurement email preferred)
- Indicate whether Pathway will prepay the first month or provide a card on file
- Any export/control or data residency constraints we should flag for Private deployments

I’ll collect the checklist and get back by EOD.

Thanks,
So-
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:05:12 -0700
Subject: RE: Pathway pilot — PO requirement + evidence needed

Soojin — thanks for the ping.

Procurement stance (short):
- Default: PO required for vendor setup. Exceptions allowed for pilots if BOTH: signed SOW + one of the following evidence items: corporate card on file OR prepayment / signed CC auth form OR internal budget owner email confirmation.
- Risk tiers: low, medium, high. Pilot deals < $5k typically low risk — exceptions are admissible with a short risk note.

What we need from Pathway to approve temporary no-PO routing:
1) Completed onboarding form (we need legal entity, tax ID, remit address).
2) Signed SOW (we have that attached).
3) Billing remit & PO exemption request email from Pathway procurement (contracts@pathwaylabs.com) stating invoice cadence preference.
4) Pathway point of contact who can sign an invoice-only rider (example language provided below).

If Pathway cannot provide corporate card or prepayment, procurement will authorize a temporary invoice-only lane for up to 3 months and <$5k, provided legal and finance sign off. We will escalate to finance for any exceptions beyond that.

Suggested next steps I can own:
- I will prepare a 1-page risk note template for the approval chain.
- If Soojin confirms, procurement can approve the temporary lane by end of day tomorrow, contingent on receiving the completed onboarding form and a formal PO-exemption request from Pathway.

Example invoice-only rider (to be completed by Pathway):
"Pathway Labs requests that Redwood Inference issue invoices monthly to accounts-payable@pathwaylabs.com for services rendered under SOW v1. Pathway understands invoices will be due Net 30 and agrees to provide a primary contact for payment follow-up."

Priya Natarajan
Senior Procurement Manager

-----

From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@pathwaylabs.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@pathwaylabs.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 13:02:27 -0700
Subject: Re: Pathway pilot — onboarding & billing: PO requirement question

Thanks Priya / Soojin — attaching the completed onboarding form, and contracts@ has signed the rider language below. We cannot prepay at scale for pilots but can provide a corporate card on file for initial billing. Remit email: accounts-payable@pathwaylabs.com.

Rider:
"Pathway Labs requests that Redwood Inference issue invoices monthly to accounts-payable@pathwaylabs.com for services rendered under SOW v1. Pathway understands invoices will be due Net 30 and agrees to provide a primary contact for payment follow-up."

Attached: completed onboarding form. Please confirm receipt and next steps so we can hit Oct 1 start.

Best,
Nora

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pathway pilot — onboarding & billing: PO requirement question

All — quick update: procurement can approve a temporary invoice-only lane for Pathway under these conditions (I confirmed with finance):

- Signed SOW v1 on file (yes)
- Completed onboarding form (received)
- Corporate card on file OR accounts-payable email + invoice-only rider (we have the rider)
- Limit: 3 months or $5k total, whichever comes first

Action items:
- Soojin: mark Pathway as "pilot-invoice-only" in HubSpot and set a 3-month reminder for procurement re-review (HubSpot: HUB-987123).
- Priya: please push the 1-page risk note and request final sign-off from Finance (cc: finance-ops@redwood.ai).
- Nora / Pathway: please confirm the card-on-file option or whether you prefer invoice-only (you indicated both; we need one).

If Pathway chooses invoice-only, finance will require a primary payment contact and an internal PO-exemption record in our vendor system. I can route the initial invoices to accounts-payable@pathwaylabs.com once procurement completes the record.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

---

Summary: temporary no-PO lane approved pending the two outstanding items: explicit confirmation of payment method (card vs invoice-only) and Priya's risk note + finance sign-off. Once those are done, we can provision the pilot environment and schedule the onboarding runbook.
